ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: There is no information in the problem statement that needs to rely on the image; solve directly according to the text conditions. It is known that the solution set of the inequality p(x)=ax^2-x+b≥0 is exactly [-2,1]. The endpoints of the solution set of a quadratic inequality are the roots of the corresponding equation ax^2-x+b=0, so -2 and 1 are the two roots of this equation. Also because the solution set of ≥0 is the finite closed interval between the two roots, this indicates that the parabola opens downward, that is, a<0. By Vieta's formulas, the sum of the two roots is -2+1=-1, while the sum of the roots of the equation ax^2-x+b=0 is -(-1)/a=1/a, therefore 1/a=-1, giving a=-1. The product of the two roots is (-2)×1=-2, while the product of the roots is b/a, therefore b/a=-2; substituting a=-1 gives b=2. Substitute a=-1, b=2 into the second inequality bx^2-x+a≤0, obtaining 2x^2-x-1≤0. Factor it as (2x+1)(x-1)≤0. Because the coefficient of the quadratic term is positive, the solution of the inequality less than or equal to zero is between the two roots, solving gives x∈[-1/2,1].

method.method_draft: 从题面读取第一个不等式为 p(x)=ax^2-x+b\ge 0，且解集正好是闭区间 [-2,1]。因为二次不等式的解集端点必为对应二次方程的根，所以 -2 和 1 是 ax^2-x+b=0 的两根；又由于解集是两根之间的有限区间，可确认开口向下。用韦达定理：两根和为 -1，而根和等于 1/a，故 a=-1；两根积为 -2，而根积等于 b/a，故 b=2。再把 a,b 代入第二个不等式 bx^2-x+a\le 0，得到 2x^2-x-1\le 0，分解为 (2x+1)(x-1)\le 0，解得 x\in[-1/2,1]。

method.method_draft: 令 p(t)=at^2-t+b，则目标二次式 q(x)=bx^2-x+a 可写成 q(x)=x^2p(1/x)（当 x\ne0）。题面给出 p(t)\ge0 的解集是 [-2,1]，因此 p(t)\le0 的区域是 (-\infty,-2]\cup[1,\infty)。对 x\ne0，q(x)\le0 等价于 p(1/x)\le0，所以需要 1/x\in(-\infty,-2]\cup[1,\infty)。分别解 1/x\le -2 与 1/x\ge1，得到 x\in[-1/2,0)\cup(0,1]。再单独检查 x=0：由于 p(t)\ge0 的解集是有限区间，原二次函数开口向下，所以 a<0，故 q(0)=a\le0，0 也应包含。合并得解集 [-1/2,1]。

设 p(t)=a t^2-t+b。题中已知不等式 p(t)≥0 的解集为 [-2,1]。目标不等式的左边为 q(x)=b x^2-x+a。对于 x≠0，有 q(x)=x^2 p(1/x)，因为 x^2 p(1/x)=x^2(a/x^2-1/x+b)=a-x+b x^2=b x^2-x+a。由于 x^2>0，所以 q(x)≤0 等价于 p(1/x)≤0。

又因为 p(t)≥0 的解集是有限区间 [-2,1]，所以二次函数开口向下，且 p(t)≤0 的范围为 (-∞,-2]∪[1,∞)。因此对 x≠0，需要 1/x∈(-∞,-2]∪[1,∞)。

分别解：1/x≤-2 得 x∈[-1/2,0)；1/x≥1 得 x∈(0,1]。所以 x≠0 时解为 [-1/2,0)∪(0,1]。

再检查 x=0。因为 p(t)≥0 的解集为有限区间，开口向下，所以 a<0，因此 q(0)=a≤0，故 x=0 也包含在解集中。

合并得到解集为 [-1/2,1]。
